name: vav guanine nucleotide exchange factor 1
pathways: regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction

function.text: VAV1 encodes proto-oncogene vav. Annotated molecular activities include guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and phosphorylation-dependent protein binding. It participates in small GTPase-mediated signal transduction and regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
